notes: VAT standard rate 16% (ZRA guides). Gold bullion is exempt ONLY when supplied to a bank (VAT (Exemption) Order, Group 8 - Metals, per the ZRA VAT Liability Guide, which expressly excludes coins, fine gold and jewellery); retail bullion therefore takes 16%. Silver appears in no exemption group: 16%. Import duty HS 7108 null (ZRA tariff book not openly readable).

sources.name: Zambia Revenue Authority (zra.org.zm) - VAT Guide 2022
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the VAT rate is 16%; all supplies are standard rated unless expressly exempted or zero rated

sources.name: Zambia Revenue Authority (zra.org.zm) - VAT Liability Guide 2022 (VAT (Exemption) Order, Group 8 - Metals)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the only metals exemption is the supply to a bank of gold in bullion form; the guide notes it does not apply to gold coins, fine gold, gold jewellery or gold in any other form
sources.quote: The supply to a bank of gold in bullion form.
